```{python}
#| label: fig-technology-corner-selection
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "One explicit scenario selects separate complete datasets. Shared layout and device interfaces remain unchanged. The nominal labels are those of the first bundled catalogs."
import drawsvg as dw
from typing import List
w,h=960,430
d=dw.Drawing(w,h)
d.append(dw.Rectangle(0,0,w,h,fill='white'))
ink='#183247'
arrow=dw.Marker(-6,-4,0,4,scale=1,orient='auto')
arrow.append(dw.Lines(-6,-4,0,0,-6,4,fill=ink,close=True))
def box(x: float, y: float, width: float, height: float, fill: str, title: str, detail: str):
    d.append(dw.Rectangle(x,y,width,height,rx=8,fill=fill,stroke=ink,stroke_width=1.5))
    d.append(dw.Text(title,19,x+14,y+29,fill=ink,font_family='sans-serif'))
    d.append(dw.Text(detail,16,x+14,y+56,fill=ink,font_family='sans-serif'))
def line(points: List[float]):
    d.append(dw.Lines(*points,stroke=ink,stroke_width=2,fill='none',marker_end=arrow))
box(20,165,210,80,'#e0efe5','Scenario: nominal','Four dataset selections')
for y,title,detail in [(20,'R dataset: nominal','Sheet, contact and via values'),
                       (120,'C dataset: nominal','Coefficients, offsets and halo'),
                       (220,'Stack: nominal','Geometry and dielectrics'),
                       (320,'References: nominal','Device capacitance estimates')]:
    box(315,y,300,80,'#dcecf7',title,detail)
    line([230,205,265,205,265,y+40,310,y+40])
    line([615,y+40,650,y+40,650,205,690,205])
box(695,155,245,100,'#e0efe5','Resolved technology','Fresh inputs for extraction')
box(695,20,245,80,'#f5ecd9','Shared definitions','Layout and device interfaces')
line([817,100,817,150])
d
```
